title: Solubility of Gp-2 Sulfates
author: 677d2e47d795586e86989380
chapter_outcomes: Define and use the terms enthalpy change of atomisation $\mathrm{\Delta H_{at}}$, and lattice energy $\mathrm{\Delta H_{latt}}$ (the change from gas phase ions to solid lattice)
Define and use the term first electron affinity, EA
Explain the factors affecting the electron affinities of elements
Describe and explain the trends in the electron affinities of the Group 16 and Group 17 elements
Construct and use Born–Haber cycles for ionic solids
Carry out calculations involving Born–Haber cycles
Explain, in qualitative terms, the effect of ionic charge and of ionic radius on the numerical magnitude of a lattice energy
Define and use the term enthalpy change with reference to hydration, $\mathrm{\Delta H_{hyd}}$, and solution, $\mathrm{\Delta H_{sol}}$
Construct and use an energy cycle involving enthalpy change of solution, lattice energy and enthalpy change of hydration
Carry out calculations involving the energy cycles
Explain, in qualitative terms, the effect of ionic charge and of ionic radius on the numerical magnitude of an enthalpy change of hydration
Define the term entropy, $S$, as the number of possible arrangements of the particles and their energy in a given system

Predict and explain the sign of the entropy changes that occur during a change in state, e.g. melting, boiling and dissolving (and their reverse), during a temperature change, and during a reaction in which there is a change in the number of gaseous molecules

Calculate the entropy change for a reaction, $\mathrm{\Delta S}$, given the standard entropies, $\mathrm{S^{\ominus}}$, of the reactants and products, $\mathrm{\Delta S^{\ominus}  = \sum S^{\ominus} (products) – \sum S^{\ominus} (reactants)}$
State and use the Gibbs equation $\mathrm{\Delta G^{\ominus}  = \Delta H^{\ominus} – T\Delta S^{\ominus}}$
Perform calculations using the equation $\mathrm{\Delta G^{\ominus} = \Delta H^{\ominus} – T\Delta S^{\ominus}}$
State whether a reaction or process will be feasible by using the sign of $\mathrm{\Delta G}$
Predict the effect of temperature change on the feasibility of a reaction, given standard enthalpy and entropy changes
